product.name: VAT Reclaim Service for Travelers
product.description: A digital service that automates VAT refund claims for travelers in France by allowing receipt uploads via banking apps and processing refunds directly to bank accounts.

product.name: Bank Integration Solutions
product.description: API and web app solutions that allow banks and card providers to offer VAT reclaim services directly to their customers within their existing digital platforms.

product.name: Automated VAT Refund Processing Platform
product.description: A technology platform leveraging AI, machine learning, and pattern recognition to identify eligible VAT purchases and automate refund processing in partnership with tax authorities.
